name: comp-256

frames.best_why: Knob rests at the far right with the full track filled and the word Amazing beside the heading.

tagline: Slide between an angry face and a smitten one to name your rating.
summary: A five-step satisfaction slider with a cross face at one end and a heart-eyes face at the other. The current step is spelled out in a word beside the prompt.
appearance: The prompt Rate your experience sits on the left with a single rating word on the right. Underneath, a red angry emoji and a grinning heart-eyes emoji bracket a white-filled slider track with a round knob.
behaviour: Dragging the knob along the track snaps through five positions and swaps the trailing word between Awful, Poor, Okay, Good and Amazing. The white fill grows behind the knob as it moves right.
demo_content: Prompt "Rate your experience" with the words Awful, Poor, Okay, Good and Amazing, opening on Okay.
search_phrases: satisfaction slider from angry to heart eyes
survey question about how it went
mood slider with emoji at both ends
drag to say how happy you are
reaction scale from bad to great
use_when: A survey or checkout wants a fast five-point satisfaction score that feels light.
avoid_when: The result is only a feeling out of five; there is no room for a written reason.
customise: The prompt, the five rating words and the two emoji are written in the source; the number of steps and their wording need edits.
weight_why: One slider, two emoji and a word; nothing animates until dragged.

a11y.note: The slider has a name, but the emoji are bare text and the rating word is not announced when the value changes.

issues: Nothing marks the five stopping points, so the knob position is the only cue for the chosen step.
polish_why: Simple and likeable, with generous emoji and a clear word readout.
title: Emoji Rating Slider
